# Fishtown Web Design

> A Philadelphia-based web design studio specializing in hand-coded, high-performance websites and local SEO. We build custom sites from scratch — no WordPress, no page builders — for small businesses, contractors, venues, startups, and non-profits.

## Services

- [Web Design](https://www.fishtownwebdesign.com/web-design): Custom hand-coded websites with 90+ PageSpeed scores
- [SEO](https://www.fishtownwebdesign.com/seo): Local search optimization and ongoing content strategy
- [SaaS Development](https://www.fishtownwebdesign.com/saas-development): Custom web application and SaaS product builds
- [App Development](https://www.fishtownwebdesign.com/app-development): Full-stack application development
- [E-commerce Web Design](https://www.fishtownwebdesign.com/ecommerce-web-design): Custom e-commerce platforms
- [Charity Program](https://www.fishtownwebdesign.com/charity): Free websites for qualifying non-profits
